sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Blank-Check Entity for Public Market Acquisition Mergers (SPAC)

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law inherited from pre-independence Anglo-French Condominium; current statutory law based on British company law principles)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus signed but not a bilateral investment treaty
No Income Tax Agreements due to zero-rate territorial tax regime

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (as amended), Companies Act [Cap 191] (domestic), Financial Transaction Reporting Act (FTRA) [Cap 151] (as amended), Anti-Money Laundering (Financial Institutions) Regulations 2019, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) AML/CFT Rules, United Nations (International Financial Obligations) Act

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each shareholder, director, and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public / relevant passport-issuing authority in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Conduct / Police Clearance for each director and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Police / relevant national criminal record authority in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and KYC clearance from the client's home bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank institution abroad (signed and stamped on bank letterhead)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Consent to act as director and shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Individual appointees (signatures notarized by a notary public)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Vanuatu registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence on all directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners; mandatory screening against the UN Consolidated List (UNSCR 1267/1989, 1988), OFAC SDN list, and Vanuatu's domestic sanctions orders made under the United Nations (International Financial Obligations) Act; mandatory PEP screening at both first-degree and extended family levels; risk-based transaction monitoring and no-use of bearer shares.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry Online Name Reservation and Clearance System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names must be in the Latin script and may be in any language using Latin characters; foreign-language names must be transliterated into Roman letters. No diacritical marks are accepted in the statutory registered name. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Ltd', 'Corp' or 'Inc'. Company names must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name in the Vanuatu Company Registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name rejection is notified by VFSC via the online reservation system. Within 14 calendar days of rejection, an applicant or the registered agent may file a written administrative appeal to VFSC's Registrar of International Companies setting out grounds of distinctiveness and proposed safeguards. VFSC must issue a response within 10 working days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may seek judicial review before the Vanuatu Supreme Court within 30 days of the denial.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted. Every International Company must maintain a registered office and registered agent physically located in Vanuatu. The VFSC will reject a filing if the registered office is merely a virtual or digital mailbox without physical presence and local authorized agent capacity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low – approximately 5% to 10% annual probability of unannounced physical inspection for a passive SPAC structure, subject to VFSC's risk-based supervision. The likelihood increases materially if the entity conducts regulated financial activity, uses trusts, or is subject to an AML/CFT investigation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name reservation and clearance fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule under the International Companies Act

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation and certificate of registration fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule – International Companies Act and VFSC Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and registered agent service – first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent / trustee company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark in the Vanuatu offshore services industry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO due diligence and PEP/sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / corporate service provider (AML compliance team)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark plus VFSC AML compliance tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of shareholder/director identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local notary public and Vanuatu consulate / Honorary Consul in country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notorial tariffs and Vanuatu Honorary Consul fixed fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of SPAC constituent documents and shareholder consents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for SPAC-vehicles in zero-tax ICA structures

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] of Vanuatu (as amended), particularly sections 3 (incorporation and capacity), 11 (registered office and registered agent), 12 (directors and officers), and 16 (share capital and allotment).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by the subscriber, submitted on VFSC Form IC-01 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Vanuatu law prescribes no minimum paid-up or issued share capital for International Companies and no statutory escrow account. For SPAC vehicles, the underwriting agreement must however contractually require IPO/offering proceeds to be deposited into a Vanuatu licensed bank trust escrow account before closing; the escrow amount is not part of the incorporation filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the shares allocated to the initial subscriber under the Memorandum and Articles of Association are approved, and the allotment and issue of such ordinary shares be recorded in the register of members. (2) That the registered office of the Company at the address nominated in the Application for Incorporation be adopted. (3) That [Name] be appointed sole director, [Name] be appointed company secretary, and [Name] be appointed chairman of the board, each to serve until the next annual general meeting or until earlier removal. (4) That the seal, bank mandate, and escrow trust account arrangements be established, and officers are authorised to execute all ancillary documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry (online via VFSC eServices portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application for the proposed SPAC entity, clearly stating its blank-check acquisition purpose, to ensure the name is not identical, undesirable, false, misleading, or obscene under the International Companies Act. Pay the applicable name reservation fee and await written VFSC approval before filing constitutive documents.
required_dossiers: Completed VFSC name reservation form
Certified copy of passport or national ID of initial subscriber/director
Power of attorney executed in favour of licensed registered agent (if applicable)
Proposed SPAC objects and corporate purpose summary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried, promptly refile using a distinguishing variation and provide a written explanation of the SPAC corporate objects to VFSC to obtain clearance; no fee refund is available for names that are rejected as misleading or undesirable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarisation of Constitutive Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu licensed registered agent / VFSC-accredited notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association incorporating SPAC-specific objects, including powers to issue units, redeem shareholders, and pursue merger or acquisition transactions. Obtain notarisation of the subscriber's signature and execute the statutory declarations required for the formation of an International Company.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (including SPAC object clauses)
Consent of first director and company secretary
Consent of registered agent and registered office
AML/KYC profile of the beneficial owner and subscribers
Notarised declaration of compliance with International Companies Act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarisation is incomplete or defective, the registered agent will return the documents to the subscriber for corrected execution and re-notarisation; a revised memorandum may be resubmitted without additional government fee if done before formal filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association together with VFSC Form IC-01. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 250 (or its Vatu equivalent) through the VFSC-approved payment channel and retain the receipt. The registered agent must verify that all attachments are properly certified and dated.
required_dossiers: VFSC Form IC-01 (Application for Incorporation)
Executed and notarised Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certified evidence of paid statutory filing fee
Registered agent acceptance letter
Identity documents of subscribers and initial directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the application for omissions or inconsistencies, submit a written response with corrected forms or a covering letter from the registered agent within 14 business days; failure to cure may result in rejection and re-filing with a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Public Register Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon successful vetting, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and enters the International Company into the public register. Verify the exact company name, number, date of incorporation, registered office address, and the registered agent details shown on the certificate before proceeding to governance setup.
required_dossiers: VFSC incorporation acknowledgment receipt
Proof of payment for statutory filing fee
Certified copy of final Memorandum and Articles of Association
Approved name reservation notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors or a defective public register entry, file a written correction request with VFSC and affidavit of subscriber; VFSC will amend the record without fee if the error is administrative, otherwise a corrective filing fee may apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convening First Board Meeting and Governance Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office of the International Company / Board of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting at the registered office or by written circular resolution. Formally adopt the first board resolution covering share allotment to the subscriber, registered office address adoption, and appointment of directors and officers. Open the bank account and establish the SPAC trust escrow account with a VFSC-licensed bank, ensuring the escrow agreement includes permitted investments and redemption mechanics.
required_dossiers: First pro-forma board resolution signed by all directors
Share certificates issued to initial subscribers
Register of members, directors, and secretaries
Bank account opening forms and trust escrow agreement
AML/CFT risk file and beneficial ownership register
Minutes or circular resolution record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any appointment or share allotment is challenged by a director or regulator, hold an extraordinary board meeting to ratify the action by majority and file an amended register; legalisation and re-execution of the affected resolution will be handled by the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Securities Division / Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Licensing Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, file the required notifications for the SPAC's securities or intermediary activity. If the SPAC will operate as a special purpose acquisition company dealing in its own securities or marketing interests to investors, apply for the appropriate securities licence under the Dealers in Securities Act. Submit the corporate governance, AML/CFT compliance manual, and designated compliance officer details. Obtain any external advice necessary to confirm whether the SPAC is exempt as a private vehicle or requires a full licence.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Adopted first board resolution
Securities investment business or dealers licence application form
AML/CFT compliance manual and risk assessment
Designated AML compliance officer consent form
Business plan and SPAC escrow/release mechanics
Financial statements or projected statement if required by VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a deficiency letter or queries the SPAC's securities activity, respond within the prescribed deadline with a curative memorandum and amended licence application; engage an approved compliance adviser if required to remedy AML/CFT gaps before re-submission.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Securities Licensing and Supervision Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Securities Investment Business Licence under the Dealers in Securities Act [Cap. 70] (or exemption letter/private vehicle confirmation as applicable to the SPAC structure)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Registration only – professional, financial and office-based administrative activities of a SPAC have no physical industrial footprint; if any office fit-out or physical adaptation occurs, the project may be classified as 'Registerable' and require an Environmental Registration or Environment Management System notice under the applicable Vanuatu environmental regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For pure SPAC office activity there is no wastewater, VOC, or waste discharge. Should office fit-out or infrastructure installation occur, comply with DEPC construction-site conditions, Vanuatu waste management standards, and approved waste disposal at licensed landfill facilities; storm water and sewage must be connected to authorised municipal systems or compliant on-site treatment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire and Rescue Services covering the registered office/fit-out; structural load clearance from the Vanuatu Public Works Department for any office alterations; and occupational health and safety clearance from the Vanuatu Department of Labour if employees are engaged. The SPAC must also maintain a business continuity and emergency evacuation plan.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; official portal and e-services: https://www.gov.vu / direct VRC e-services
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Not applicable in default because an International Company operates extraterritorially and does not require a TIN. If the IC nonetheless makes onshore taxable supplies or needs to file a VAT return, the registered agent must submit the VRC standard Taxpayer Registration Form together with the certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, registered office certificate, identity/passport copies of directors and beneficial owners, and evidence of authorized signatories. A unique 10-digit TIN is issued within 5 working days. Foreign entities without a Vanuatu physical presence must maintain a licensed registered agent and provide a certified copy of the agency appointment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election regime. An International Company is automatically tax-exempt. The only statutory elections relevant here are: (1) filing a notice under the International Companies Act confirming non-resident/offshore status; and (2) conversion or deregistration as an ordinary company under the Companies Act (Cap 191), which terminates automatic tax exemption. For VAT, voluntary registration is available but does not trigger any hybrid entity election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 per annum (approx. USD 45,000) of taxable turnover from onshore supplies
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital stamping regime is in force in Vanuatu. VAT invoices may be issued in hard copy or PDF and must contain prescribed particulars (supplier TIN, VAT rate, gross consideration). Taxpayers are not required to pre-clear invoice series with the VRC, but must retain invoices and supporting documentation for 7 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A registered VAT supplier may zero-rate: (a) goods physically exported from Vanuatu within 28 days of invoice, supported by customs export declarations and transport documents; and (b) services supplied to a non-resident recipient where the direct benefit is wholly outside Vanuatu and the services do not relate to Vanuatu land or goods. Financial services (including escrow, share dealing, and SPAC acquisition services) are generally exempt from VAT, but may be zero-rated as an export of services where the recipient is non-resident and the benefit is realized offshore. An International Company operating as an offshore SPAC is normally outside the VAT net and does not register. Input VAT can only be recovered if the IC registers voluntarily and makes a taxable supply in Vanuatu.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The VRC may audit zero-rated export claims for up to 7 years. Non-documentary compliance attracts a monthly penalty of 5% of the VAT understated plus interest at 10% p.a. Knowingly false or fraudulent claims trigger a penalty equal to 200% of the tax evaded, criminal fines of up to VUV 10,000,000, imprisonment of officers for up to 10 years, retrospective reassessment and clawback of all zero-rating relief. In addition, the Registrar under the International Companies Act may revoke an IC's tax-exempt status where the entity is found to have engaged in onshore business activity.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) as the monetary authority and custodian of foreign exchange policy; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) as the corporate and securities regulator responsible for International Company licensing, SPAC listing conduct, and AML/CFT supervision.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalised, no-exchange-control regime. Both current and capital account transactions are fully convertible in Vatu (VUV), which floats against a currency basket. International Companies (ICs) face no restriction on capital injection, profit remittance, dividend repatriation, or liquidation proceeds transfer. No RBV approval is required for foreign exchange conversion or outward remittance for a SPAC escrow vehicle. Convertibility is practically unlimited; the domestic banking system clears transactions in USD, AUD, EUR, and VUV, with the VUV quoted freely against all major currencies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender or conversion of export proceeds. All export receipts, including service fees and transaction revenues, may be retained in any foreign currency or converted on the entity's own discretion. There are no mandatory timelines, minimum conversion ratios, or RBV directives requiring repatriation into VUV for International Companies or SPAC structures.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (USD trust) and Operational VUV Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low — Vanuatu law does not recognise non-resident e-money institutions as escrow custodians or deposit-takers. Offshore digital EMIs can provide only payment information facilitation on top of a licensed RBV clearing bank; they cannot hold SPAC proceeds in trust or maintain title to capital subscriptions. Use of an unlicensed EMI would create significant AML/CFT and insolvency exposure for the SPAC.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is not always mandatory for International Company account opening if the entity is introduced by a VFSC-registered agent and UBO documentation is executed before a notary in a recognised jurisdiction. However, RBV AML/CFT directives require a live interactive interview (in-person or secure remote video) with the natural-person signatories and the ultimate beneficial owner. For a SPAC classified as Medium-Risk Enhanced, the domestic bank will normally require a remote video interview with the secretary and the UBO, together with notarised board resolutions and a signed escrow mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Blank-check shell entity with no historical financial statements and wide-purpose SPAC investment mandate
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC International Company certificate; certificate of incumbency; SPAC trust agreement with a regulated custodian; formal prospectus or offering memorandum; source-of-funds bank statements of sponsors; UBO and signatory passports with verification; proof of physical address; and a legal opinion from Vanuatu counsel confirming lawful purpose, non-shell operational plan, and adherence to the Securities Dealers Licensing Act.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived nominee ownership or unreported trust/arrangement inside the escrow chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full beneficial ownership declaratory form; deed of trust; trust register extract or equivalent; signed undertaking from each UBO; group corporate structure chart; references from the sponsor's principal bankers; notarised consent from any third-party nominee; and an AML/CFT compliance report showing ongoing beneficial ownership monitoring.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicious counterparty geography or divergence between designated clearing rails and final SPAC merger target
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed target-company acquisition agreement; CRS/FATCA self-declarations; clearing-rail mandate restricted to SWIFT MT103 and Commercial LC instruments; documentary evidence of the announced acquisition timeline; independent due-diligence report on target jurisdiction; and an officer-to-officer confirmation letter from the receiving bank clarifying the purpose of each inbound / outbound instruction.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant sponsors' inbound wires use SWIFT MT103 with a transparent purpose code, preferably 9210 (Internal transfer) for subscribed capital or 5620 (Acquisition financing) for SPAC sponsor loans. Each wire must reference the SPAC trust deed and the escrow account number as the ultimate beneficiary. The Vanuatu receiving bank will verify against the VFSC registry and match the remitter with the SPAC's disclosed UBOs. No RBV exchange-control approval is needed, but thorough KYC and beneficial-ownership records must be annexed at first injection and periodically refreshed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement rails for SPAC completion and redemptions consist of SWIFT MT103 wire transfers routed through our nostro correspondents in Australia, Singapore, and New Zealand, or Commercial Letters of Credit where the series-B merger consideration is conditioned on documentary compliance. For redemption events, funds flow by MT103 to the investors' recorded banks, matched to a fund-level share register. VUV/USD clearing on domestic books is executed via the same SWIFT rail with cover payment to preserve an independent audit trail and mitigate settlement risk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts referencing VUV/USD or the acquisition currency, settled in USD net cash at maturity — permissible for non-resident SPAC vehicles.
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) under ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a qualified international dealer — permitted despite the absence of an onshore derivatives market.
Plain-vanilla FX forwards with an RBV-licensed commercial bank, generally limited to a term matching a fixed SPAC acquisition or redemption date.
Currency options may be embedded in structured escrow products only when the bank acts as licensed principal; OTC options between unlicensed third parties are not permissible onshore in Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Compliance Declaration (prescribed form for International Companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VUV 20,000 (approx. USD 170) per month or fraction; persistent failure for two consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution after notice under the International Companies Act.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for International Companies under the IC Act; audit becomes compulsory only if the SPAC holds a financial services license under the Vanuatu Financial Dealers Act, or if a listing authority or trust escrow agreement mandates audited financial statements
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or IFRS for SMEs, as applied in Vanuatu; accounts need not be filed with the VFSC for International Companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public UBO register in Vanuatu. The registered agent must maintain an up-to-date beneficial ownership record and obtain an annual confirmation that no share transfers have occurred without notification; VFSC may call for this record at any time. Share transfer notifications must be routed through the agent within 14 days.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,000 – US$8,000 per audit if triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; International Companies under the International Companies Act Cap 222 are expressly exempt from all taxation on income, profits and distributions)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory 0% effective rate for all International Companies; the exemption extends to capital gains, interest, royalties and dividends. International Companies are also exempt from stamp duty on the issuance and transfer of shares and are outside the VAT net except for local procurement transactions, where VAT at the prevailing statutory rate (historically 12.5% since introduction in 2015 and subject to legislative amendment) may apply only to local taxable goods or services acquired by the IC. No CIT loss relief exists because no taxable base is assessable; the 5-year carry-forward convention is retained solely for system interoperability and has no operative effect in Vanuatu law.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Nil corporate income tax return for International Companies (no CIT filing obligation). Annual compliance is discharged by filing the VFSC IC Annual Return under the International Companies Act Cap 222 together with the Beneficial Ownership Confirmation Statement and, where triggered, the Vanuatu Economic Substance Notification and Report under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2022; all submissions are made through a licensed VFSC Registered Agent using the VFSC electronic registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return must be lodged within 60 days after the anniversary date of incorporation; the ESR Notification is due within 6 months after the financial year end and the ESR Report within 12 months after the financial year end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, registration number, date of incorporation, current registered office in Port Vila and principal place of business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident sole directors and shareholders may complete the form through the Vanuatu Registered Agent; no Vanuatu tax identification number is required because the IC has nil CIT exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital by class, par value, total number of issued shares, identity of each shareholder and percentage ownership.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Owners may be natural or legal persons of any jurisdiction; any bearer shares must be immobilised with the Registered Agent. Foreign SPAC sponsors must attach the trust or escrow deed evidencing the held-in-trust founder share structure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, nationality and passport details of directors and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; VFSC requires the Registered Agent to verify identity under the VFSC AML/CFT Rules and retain certified copies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation by the licensed Registered Agent that the company is in good standing, that the annual compliance fee has been paid, and that AML customer due diligence has been refreshed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Registered Agent acts as statutory gateway; the overseas beneficial owner must respond to agent due-diligence requests within the statutory 14-day window.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the IC carries on a relevant activity, the nature of that activity, jurisdiction of tax residence, quantum of Vanuatu income, number of employees, physical premises and operating expenditure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A SPAC that merely holds escrow proceeds and has no employees or premises in Vanuatu must not falsely self-certify as a pure equity holding entity unless the legal conditions are strictly met; professional ESR advice is mandatory before submission.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 (Escrow Account and Wire Payment Particulars)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bank account details for the SPAC trust or escrow account, permitted wire corridors, and confirmation that all IPO and founder proceeds are held in a segregated custody account pending a business combination.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: SWIFT wire instructions to the escrow bank must designate the IC as account holder and the trustee as signatory; non-resident ultimate beneficiaries must be identified to the Vanuatu Registered Agent for AML file closure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of VUV 20,000 to VUV 60,000 per return (approximately USD 170 to USD 500), risk of automatic deregistration after 3 months, and restoration fee of approximately VUV 50,000. ESR non-compliance attracts penalties from VUV 500,000 up to VUV 10,000,000, daily default penalties of VUV 50,000, and publication on the VFSC non-compliant register.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu Economic Substance Report and Notification — administered by VFSC under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2022; filed electronically through the licensed Registered Agent portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: ESR Notification due within 6 months of financial year end; substantive ESR Report due within 12 months of financial year end. The financial year may be aligned to the IC anniversary with Registered Agent approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal entity type, date of incorporation, and confirmation that no Vanuatu CIT is payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All International Companies, including SPAC vehicles, are relevant entities and must file even when income is nil.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the relevant activity conducted: banking, insurance, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, shipping, distribution and service centre, or pure equity holding.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A SPAC is ordinarily characterised as a treasury or holding vehicle; the Registered Agent must map the business plan to a defensible ESR category, usually pure equity holding company where acquisitions are not yet consummated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Details of board meetings held in Vanuatu, strategy and risk decisions made in Vanuatu, full-time employees in Vanuatu, leased premises, and annual operating expenditure incurred in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident SPAC managers cannot claim substance solely through signatures; at least one substantive board meeting per financial year should be physically held in Port Vila, with minutes and travel records retained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box D (Outsourcing and Transfer Pricing Declaration)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of any outsourcing of core income-generating functions and the arm's length consideration paid to related parties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees paid to the SPAC sponsor, underwriters or foreign affiliates must be supported by transfer pricing documentation showing a justified basis; the Vanuatu zero CIT regime does not remove the need for OECD-compliant benchmarking where foreign tax authorities re-examine conduit profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Country of tax residence of the entity and the basis for that treatment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors must identify whether the SPAC or its ultimate parent is tax resident in the United States, Hong Kong, Singapore or the Cayman Islands; Vanuatu will transmit ESR data under international exchange mechanisms to those revenue authorities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file ESR documents attracts a fixed penalty of VUV 500,000, a daily default penalty of VUV 50,000 and a statutory maximum of VUV 10,000,000 (approximately USD 83,000); repeated failure leads to strike-off and an adverse mutual-assistance finding reported to the OECD Global Forum and the EU Code of Conduct Group.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company, whether to residents or non-residents; dividend distributions from SPAC trust or escrow proceeds are therefore tax-free at source in Vanuatu.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu does not maintain a comprehensive double tax treaty network; its international instruments are primarily Tax Information Exchange Agreements (for example with Australia, Canada, Denmark, Finland, Greenland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden). Because the domestic withholding tax rate is already zero, no DTA relief, tax-sparing credit or Vanuatu Tax Residency Certificate is required to repatriate dividends or interest. Where a foreign jurisdiction needs confirmation of the IC's exempt status, the beneficial owner should obtain a Certificate of Tax Exemption issued under section 160 of the International Companies Act through the Registered Agent, normally within 7 to 14 working days.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Vanuatu rate: 0% for royalties and 0% for debt interest paid by an International Company, as no domestic withholding tax code exists. Treaty rate: 0% because no comprehensive DTA is operative; the foreign recipient remains fully taxable in its residence jurisdiction. For SPAC bridge financing, escrow interest sweeps and IP licence arrangements, the underlying debt and IP documentation must be retained to rebut any allegation of a sham or improper conduit.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Vanuatu statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold exists because no CIT is levied. However, under the IC ESR Regime, any relevant entity with annual gross income of VUV 10,000,000 (approximately USD 83,000) or more, or with intra-group cross-border transactions above VUV 5,000,000 (approximately USD 42,000), should maintain a Local File and Master File as best practice. Foreign parent jurisdictions (for example the United States, Hong Kong or EU Member States) will apply their own documentation thresholds and penalties to the Vanuatu SPAC, commonly USD 10,000,000 to USD 20,000,000 of gross revenue or covered transactions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2022 requires every Vanuatu International Company, including an ISIC 6499 SPAC blank-check vehicle, to satisfy the economic substance test applicable to its relevant activity. A pre-deal SPAC holding IPO proceeds will normally be assessed as a pure equity holding entity and therefore subject to light substance requirements: own registered office, adequate records and full compliance. The moment the SPAC earns management fees, receives material interest on escrow, or executes a business combination, classification shifts to financing and leasing or headquarters, with full substance requirements: Vanuatu board control, local employment, local premises and proportionate local expenditure. Failure to meet the test invalidates the IC's claim to the zero-tax regime and exposes directors to disclosure to the OECD and EU.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Abusive Conduit Arrangements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC's zero-rate 0% tax status to strip profits from a high-tax operating group without real commercial substance, mis-declaring the SPAC as an inactive shell while actually conducting investment or treasury activity, or failing to disclose Vanuatu tax status and ESR facts to foreign revenue authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2022: penalty up to VUV 10,000,000 (approximately USD 83,000), daily default penalty of VUV 50,000, disqualification orders and strike-off. Under Vanuatu's anti-money-laundering framework, false statutory declarations attract imprisonment up to 12 years and fines up to VUV 15,000,000. The foreign parent additionally faces GAAR recharacterisation, CFC inclusions, withholding assessments and civil penalties in its residence jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors are personally liable for penalties where they knew or were reckless as to the false declaration; courts may lift the corporate veil, impose travel bans and asset-freezing orders, order unjust enrichment restitution equal to the profits routed through the IC, and in aggravated cross-border fraud cases imprison directors for up to 12 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a SPAC as a pure letterbox entity with no Vanuatu board meetings, no decision-making records, no local service arrangement, and no ESR filing, while claiming offshore tax-exempt status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC deregistration and notation on the public Non-Compliant Entities register; a VUV 500,000 penalty for each year of non-compliance up to VUV 10,000,000; mandatory adverse OECD/EU cross-border information-exchange reports, resulting in loss of banking relationships and de-risking at the escrow bank.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director is jointly and severally liable for restoration costs, ESR penalties and the costs of judicial liquidation; personal sanctions include a five-year ban on acting as a director of any VFSC-licensed entity and, where escrow monies were misapplied, criminal conversion convictions with imprisonment up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain or file up-to-date beneficial ownership records, accepting unauthorised third-party funds into the SPAC escrow account, executing SWIFT wires to sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions, or allowing IPO shares to be used for money laundering after the business combination.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act and VFSC AML Rules: fines up to VUV 25,000,000 (approximately USD 208,000) per violation, revocation of the IC's registration and of the Registered Agent's licence, confiscation of escrow and merger proceeds, and referral to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and foreign law enforcement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, the Registered Agent and the escrow trustee face personal criminal liability for consenting to suspicious transactions; statutory penalties include imprisonment up to 12 years, forfeiture of personal assets under civil recovery, a 10-year banking ban and travel restrictions preventing departure from Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Economic Substance Reporting / Fraudulent Misrepresentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting an ESR Report that falsely certifies the existence of Vanuatu employees, premises or board proceedings, or misclassifying a financed acquisition vehicle as a pure equity holding entity solely to obtain the lighter substance test.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines of VUV 10,000,000 and daily default penalties; criminal prosecution for false declaration before the VFSC; deregistration; and mandatory exchange of information with the OECD/EU Global Forum, leading to blacklisting of the Vanuatu jurisdiction and removal of concessionary status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The signatory director and the Registered Agent officer are personally liable; courts can impose civil restitution of all fees and interest earned by non-resident sponsors, a 10-year director disqualification, a travel ban pending investigation, and imprisonment up to 12 years for fraud.
